summaries.advisory: Chartered Accountant who has worked on both sides of a deal: diligencing a healthcare InsurTech acquisition structured through a demerger, and getting an industrial & logistics platform IPO-ready alongside a Big 4 team. Three years of audit on companies with ₹2,000+ Cr turnover taught me how numbers break; modelling and valuation are how I now put them to work.
summaries.fpa: Chartered Accountant who builds the plans and reports management actually uses: an annual operating plan tested against prior-year actuals, Power BI variance dashboards, and MIS and fund-flow reporting during a ₹2,600 Cr IPO preparation. Three years of audit on companies with ₹2,000+ Cr turnover give me a sharp eye for where numbers go wrong.
summaries.consulting: Chartered Accountant who likes working out how an unfamiliar business really makes money, from a healthcare InsurTech acquisition to an industrial & logistics platform preparing for IPO. I turn messy situations into usable outputs: operating plans, controls and SOPs, dashboards and automation that saved 50+ hours a month.
